set.body:
Add the missing producer-owned temporal inspection seam required by owner-authorized workstream5 and StoryAtlas bd-01M354JNKNKJ15N4T5MGQTRSET. Existing live temporal producer remains qualified; its live execution decoder must not admit imported claims as execution authority.

Acceptance: an inspection-only facade validates exact workspace policy bytes, complete source/inventory/rows and optional checked recall timing; reuses producer temporal arithmetic for arbitrary regions/rebin/top-k; retains measure, processing, source/external/unavailable/outside/omitted mass and exact ticks. No conversion to MappingResult, MappingRun.Execution or live stage receipts. Live and imported numerical known answers agree while authority and identities differ. Altered valid imported bytes change identity despite an unchanged claimed record digest. Foreign joins and forgery doors refuse. Missing/onset-only timing stays unavailable/zero-duration as appropriate. ADR amendment, independent readback, mutations, scoped cross-platform and exact consumer tests, and independent exact-SHA review required. Parent delivery epic bd-01M2TA01EHVRF6MQ1N00XTVK1K; supports existing temporal producer bd-01M3549Q5W5KQFSY3ZH81FARM0 without erasing its completed evidence.
set.title: Add inspection-only temporal queries for imported workspaces
